name: marketingskills-audit-tools
description: Local, open-source browser/crawl tooling for client-audit-report and seo-audit — Core Web Vitals, rendered schema markup, broken links, and site screenshots. Unlike tools/clis (zero-dependency API wrappers), these need one `npm install` because they drive a real browser.

scripts.postinstall: playwright install chromium --with-deps || playwright install chromium
